泄露.zh: 期末考试的试题被人提前泄露了，学校只好连夜重新出题。
泄露.en: The final exam questions were leaked in advance, so the school had to write new ones overnight.

着迷.zh: 他对天文学很着迷，常常半夜起来用望远镜看星星。
着迷.en: He is fascinated by astronomy and often gets up in the middle of the night to look at the stars through a telescope.

典礼.zh: 九月一日，全校师生在操场上举行了隆重的开学典礼。
典礼.en: On 1 September, the whole school held a grand ceremony on the sports field to open the new term.

皆.zh: 错别字在学生的作文里比比皆是，老师改得很头疼。
皆.en: Miswritten characters are everywhere in students' essays, and marking them gives the teacher a headache.

抵抗.zh: 孩子的抵抗力比较弱，换季的时候特别容易感冒。
抵抗.en: Children have fairly weak resistance and catch colds especially easily when the seasons change.

战术.zh: 这支篮球队采用了快速进攻的战术，打得对手措手不及。
战术.en: The basketball team used fast-attack tactics and caught their opponents off guard.

操纵.zh: 有人在背后操纵比赛结果，几名球员因此被终身禁赛。
操纵.en: Someone was rigging match results behind the scenes, and several players were banned for life.

局面.zh: 主队连得五分，终于扭转了落后的局面。
局面.en: The home team scored five points in a row and finally turned around a losing position.

设置.zh: 为了保护隐私，他给电脑设置了一个复杂的密码。
设置.en: To protect his privacy, he set a complicated password on his computer.

奇妙.zh: 我们竟然在国外偶遇了小学同桌，缘分真是太奇妙了。
奇妙.en: We actually ran into my primary-school deskmate abroad; fate really is a wonderful thing.

消除.zh: 睡前泡个热水澡能消除一天的疲劳。
消除.en: Taking a hot bath before bed can get rid of a whole day's fatigue.

代理.zh: 这家公司是那个外国品牌在中国的独家代理。
代理.en: This company is the exclusive agent of that foreign brand in China.

防止.zh: 下雪天路面很滑，开车时要放慢速度，防止发生事故。
防止.en: Roads are slippery on snowy days, so slow down when driving to prevent accidents.

纯粹.zh: 别听他的，他说的那些纯粹是胡说八道。
纯粹.en: Don't listen to him; what he says is pure nonsense.

场面.zh: 春节前的火车站人山人海，场面十分壮观。
场面.en: Before Spring Festival the train station is packed with people, and the scene is spectacular.

窝.zh: 我家的猫昨天生了一窝小猫，一共五只。
窝.en: Our cat gave birth to a litter of kittens yesterday, five in all.

幢.zh: 学校去年新建了一幢六层的教学楼。
幢.en: Last year the school built a new six-storey teaching building.

超越.zh: 他在这次比赛中超越了自我，打破了个人最好成绩。
超越.en: In this competition he surpassed himself and broke his personal best.

明明.zh: 他明明已经吃饱了，却还说自己饿。
明明.en: He has obviously already eaten his fill, yet he still says he is hungry.

原始.zh: 那个地区至今还保留着大片原始森林。
原始.en: That region still preserves large areas of primeval forest today.

不惜.zh: 为了按时完成项目，他不惜连续加班一个星期。
不惜.en: To finish the project on time, he did not hesitate to work overtime for a whole week.

祖父.zh: 这块手表是祖父留给父亲的，已经有六十多年的历史了。
祖父.en: This watch was left to my father by my grandfather; it is more than sixty years old.

永恒.zh: 世界上没有永恒不变的事物，一切都在发展。
永恒.en: Nothing in the world stays the same forever; everything is developing.

弱点.zh: 贪小便宜是人性的弱点，骗子正是利用了这一点。
弱点.en: Wanting something for nothing is a weakness of human nature, and that is exactly what swindlers exploit.

投诉.zh: 邻居家深夜还在唱歌，他忍不住打电话向物业投诉。
投诉.en: The neighbours were still singing late at night, so he couldn't help calling property management to complain.

高潮.zh: 晚会进入高潮时，全场观众都站起来跟着唱。
高潮.en: When the party reached its climax, the whole audience stood up and sang along.

拽.zh: 小狗一看见公园，就使劲拽着绳子往前跑。
拽.en: As soon as the puppy saw the park, it tugged hard on the leash and ran ahead.

火焰.zh: 壁炉里的火焰越烧越旺，屋子里很快暖和起来。
火焰.en: The flames in the fireplace grew stronger and the room soon warmed up.

服从.zh: 球员必须服从教练的安排，不能想怎么踢就怎么踢。
服从.en: Players must obey the coach's arrangements and cannot just play however they like.

信念.zh: 她始终怀着一个信念：只要努力，就一定能实现梦想。
信念.en: She always held one belief: as long as you work hard, you can realise your dream.

贿赂.zh: 那家公司用贵重礼物贿赂检查人员，最后被罚了一大笔钱。
贿赂.en: That company bribed the inspectors with expensive gifts and was eventually fined a large sum.

签署.zh: 这份文件必须由总经理本人签署才能生效。
签署.en: This document only takes effect once the general manager has signed it personally.

故障.zh: 由于信号系统发生故障，地铁晚点了二十分钟。
故障.en: Because the signalling system broke down, the subway was twenty minutes late.

舱.zh: 飞机降落后，乘客们按顺序走出了机舱。
舱.en: After the plane landed, the passengers left the cabin in order.

打仗.zh: 爷爷常给我们讲他年轻时当兵打仗的故事。
打仗.en: Grandpa often tells us stories of his days as a young soldier at war.

创作.zh: 这位作家花了五年时间才完成这部长篇小说的创作。
创作.en: The writer spent five years completing this novel.

分散.zh: 下了旅游车，游客们分散在广场的各个角落拍照。
分散.en: After getting off the tour bus, the tourists scattered to every corner of the square to take photos.

咋.zh: 这个字咋念？我查了半天字典也没找到。
咋.en: How do you pronounce this character? I searched the dictionary for ages and couldn't find it.

降临.zh: 好运突然降临到他头上，他竟然中了大奖。
降临.en: Good luck suddenly befell him: he actually won the grand prize.

棕色.zh: 这只小熊有一身棕色的毛，看起来非常可爱。
棕色.en: This little bear has brown fur all over and looks very cute.

推测.zh: 科学家根据化石推测，这种动物生活在一亿年前。
推测.en: Based on the fossils, scientists infer that this animal lived a hundred million years ago.

官方.zh: 请到官方网站上下载这个软件，以免感染病毒。
官方.en: Please download this software from the official website to avoid getting a virus.

坟墓.zh: 考古学家在山脚下发现了一座两千多年前的坟墓。
坟墓.en: Archaeologists discovered a tomb more than two thousand years old at the foot of the mountain.

曲子.zh: 这首曲子旋律很简单，听两遍就会哼了。
曲子.en: This tune has a simple melody; after hearing it twice you can hum it.

实施.zh: 这个计划听起来不错，但实施起来困难很多。
实施.en: This plan sounds good, but carrying it out involves a lot of difficulties.

贵族.zh: 在古代欧洲，只有贵族才有机会接受良好的教育。
贵族.en: In ancient Europe, only the nobility had the chance to receive a good education.

陈述.zh: 在法庭上，证人清楚地陈述了事情的经过。
陈述.en: In court, the witness clearly stated what had happened.

敞开.zh: 朋友之间应该敞开心扉，有什么话直说。
敞开.en: Friends should open their hearts to each other and say whatever is on their minds.

边境.zh: 我们坐火车到了边境，然后换乘汽车出国。
边境.en: We took the train to the border and then switched to a bus to leave the country.

掩饰.zh: 这件衣服很宽松，正好能掩饰她身材上的缺点。
掩饰.en: This loose garment happens to conceal the flaws in her figure.

维护.zh: 这台电脑需要定期维护，才能保持良好的运行速度。
维护.en: This computer needs regular maintenance to keep running at a good speed.

终点.zh: 这趟公交车的终点是火车站，你坐到底就行。
终点.en: This bus terminates at the train station, so just ride it to the end.

野蛮.zh: 有人觉得用手抓饭吃很野蛮，其实这只是习惯不同。
野蛮.en: Some people think eating with your hands is uncivilised, but it is really just a different custom.

厌恶.zh: 她对香烟的气味感到十分厌恶。
厌恶.en: She finds the smell of cigarettes utterly disgusting.

责怪.zh: 妈妈没有责怪打碎花瓶的弟弟，反而先看他有没有受伤。
责怪.en: Mum didn't blame my little brother for breaking the vase; instead she first checked whether he was hurt.

漫长.zh: 这里的冬天非常漫长，从十月一直持续到第二年四月。
漫长.en: Winter here is very long, lasting from October until April of the following year.

赞助.zh: 这部纪录片得到了一家银行的赞助，才顺利拍完。
赞助.en: This documentary was completed only thanks to sponsorship from a bank.

预料.zh: 谁也没预料到这场雨会下得这么大。
预料.en: No one expected this rain to be so heavy.

正当.zh: 消费者应该学会用法律保护自己的正当权益。
正当.en: Consumers should learn to use the law to protect their legitimate rights and interests.

堕落.zh: 他从一个优秀的学生堕落成了整天逃课的人，让父母很伤心。
堕落.en: He went downhill from an excellent student to someone who skips class all day, which broke his parents' hearts.

合并.zh: 这两家小银行合并以后，成为了当地最大的银行。
合并.en: After the two small banks merged, they became the largest bank in the area.

丢人.zh: 在全班同学面前摔了一跤，他觉得丢人极了。
丢人.en: He fell over in front of the whole class and felt utterly embarrassed.

极端.zh: 这个地区的气候非常极端，夏天酷热，冬天严寒。
极端.en: The climate in this region is extreme: scorching summers and bitterly cold winters.

年度.zh: 公司正在准备下一年度的预算，各部门都很忙。
年度.en: The company is preparing next year's budget, and every department is busy.

机械.zh: 这家工厂引进了新的机械设备，生产效率提高了一倍。
机械.en: This factory brought in new machinery, and its production efficiency doubled.

拘留.zh: 那个在机场闹事的乘客被警察拘留了。
拘留.en: The passenger who caused a disturbance at the airport was detained by the police.

刹车.zh: 这辆自行车的刹车坏了，骑起来很危险。
刹车.en: The brakes on this bicycle are broken, so it is dangerous to ride.

裁判.zh: 那名球员对裁判的判罚很不满，当场提出了抗议。
裁判.en: The player was unhappy with the referee's decision and protested on the spot.

巡逻.zh: 暑假期间，海边有救生员来回巡逻，保护游客的安全。
巡逻.en: During the summer holiday, lifeguards patrol the beach to keep visitors safe.

噪音.zh: 这台新洗衣机工作时几乎没有噪音。
噪音.en: This new washing machine makes almost no noise when it runs.

分裂.zh: 因为意见不合，这个乐队最终分裂了。
分裂.en: Because of disagreements, the band eventually split up.

定义.zh: 数学课上，老师先解释了三角形的定义。
定义.en: In maths class, the teacher first explained the definition of a triangle.

呕吐.zh: 吃了不干净的东西后，他开始肚子疼、呕吐。
呕吐.en: After eating something contaminated, he started having stomach pains and vomiting.

羞耻.zh: 他把别人的文章当成自己的，竟然一点羞耻心都没有。
羞耻.en: He passed off someone else's essay as his own and showed no sense of shame at all.

清洁.zh: 每天下班后，清洁工人都会把办公室打扫得干干净净。
清洁.en: Every day after work, the cleaners tidy the office until it is spotless.

恐吓.zh: 他收到一封恐吓信，马上就报了警。
恐吓.en: He received a threatening letter and immediately called the police.

轨道.zh: 经过一个月的调整，工厂的生产终于回到了正常轨道。
轨道.en: After a month of adjustments, the factory's production finally got back on track.

视线.zh: 她的视线一直没有离开过舞台上的儿子。
视线.en: Her eyes never left her son on the stage.

帐篷.zh: 夜里下起了大雨，雨水把帐篷都打湿了。
帐篷.en: Heavy rain fell during the night and soaked the tent.

串.zh: 妈妈从市场买回来一串新鲜的葡萄。
串.en: Mum brought home a bunch of fresh grapes from the market.

遗传.zh: 医生说这种病和遗传有关，家里人最好都去检查一下。
遗传.en: The doctor said this illness is hereditary, so the whole family had better get checked.

血压.zh: 吃得太咸容易导致血压升高。
血压.en: Eating too much salt can easily raise your blood pressure.

氧气.zh: 植物在阳光下会吸收二氧化碳，放出氧气。
氧气.en: In sunlight, plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen.

十足.zh: 这个演员的表演幽默十足，逗得观众哈哈大笑。
十足.en: This actor's performance was full of humour and had the audience roaring with laughter.

携带.zh: 外出旅行时，最好随身携带一些常用药。
携带.en: When travelling, it is best to carry some common medicines with you.

检验.zh: 这次考试可以检验大家这学期的学习效果。
检验.en: This exam can test how much everyone has learned this term.

守护.zh: 这只大狗每天晚上都守护在主人的门口。
守护.en: Every night this big dog stands guard at its owner's door.

鉴于.zh: 鉴于他在工作中的出色表现，公司决定给他升职。
鉴于.en: In view of his outstanding performance at work, the company decided to promote him.

误解.zh: 很多人误解了这句话的意思，其实它是在表扬人。
误解.en: Many people misunderstand this sentence; it is actually praising someone.

震撼.zh: 第一次看到大海时，那种壮观的景象让我十分震撼。
震撼.en: The first time I saw the sea, the magnificent sight left me stunned.

例外.zh: 他每天早上都去跑步，今天下雨也不例外。
例外.en: He goes running every morning, and today, even though it is raining, is no exception.

跳跃.zh: 这篇文章思路太跳跃了，读者很难跟上。
跳跃.en: This article's line of thought jumps around too much for readers to follow.

民主.zh: 我们家做决定很民主，每个人都可以发表意见。
民主.en: Our family makes decisions very democratically; everyone can give their opinion.

掐.zh: 他每天都掐着点儿到公司，从来不早到一分钟。
掐.en: Every day he arrives at the office right on the dot, never a minute early.

打包.zh: 搬家前，我们花了两天时间把所有东西打包好。
打包.en: Before moving, we spent two days packing everything up.

地步.zh: 他的房间乱到了找不到一双袜子的地步。
地步.en: His room is so messy that he can't even find a pair of socks.

保卫.zh: 他在大学的保卫处工作，负责整个校园的安全。
保卫.en: He works in the university's security office and is responsible for the safety of the whole campus.

防御.zh: 刺猬身上的刺是它用来防御敌人的武器。
防御.en: A hedgehog's spines are the weapon it uses to defend itself against enemies.

撤销.zh: 由于证据不足，法院撤销了原来的判决。
撤销.en: Because of insufficient evidence, the court overturned the original verdict.

妄想.zh: 他整天躺在家里，却妄想一夜之间变成富翁。
妄想.en: He lies around at home all day, yet vainly hopes to become rich overnight.

命名.zh: 这家公司用创始人女儿的名字给新产品命名。
命名.en: The company named its new product after the founder's daughter.

事务.zh: 他退休后积极参与社区事务，比上班时还忙。
事务.en: After retiring he took an active part in community affairs and is busier than when he was working.

解放.zh: 考试终于结束了，我感觉整个人都解放了。
解放.en: The exams are finally over, and I feel completely liberated.

司法.zh: 法律专业的学生毕业前大多会参加司法考试。
司法.en: Most law students take the judicial exam before they graduate.

谣言.zh: 所谓明天放假的消息只是谣言，大家还是要按时上学。
谣言.en: The so-called news that tomorrow is a holiday is just a rumour; everyone still has to come to school on time.

版本.zh: 这本小说有好几个英文版本，翻译质量差别很大。
版本.en: This novel has several English versions, and the quality of the translations varies widely.

报酬.zh: 这份兼职工作很辛苦，报酬却很低。
报酬.en: This part-time job is hard work, but the pay is low.

动静.zh: 孩子睡得很轻，一有动静就会醒。
动静.en: The child sleeps lightly and wakes at the slightest sound.

着想.zh: 你不能只考虑自己，也要替别人着想。
着想.en: You can't think only of yourself; you should consider others too.

人性.zh: 这部小说深刻地揭示了人性中善良和自私的两面。
人性.en: This novel profoundly reveals both the kind and the selfish sides of human nature.

丧失.zh: 那场意外让他永远丧失了听力。
丧失.en: That accident caused him to lose his hearing for good.

铺.zh: 工人们正在给这条小路铺石板。
铺.en: The workers are paving this path with stone slabs.

辐射.zh: 太阳的热量以辐射的方式传到地球上。
辐射.en: The sun's heat reaches the earth by radiation.

粗鲁.zh: 在餐厅里拍着桌子叫服务员是一种很粗鲁的行为。
粗鲁.en: Banging on the table to call a waiter in a restaurant is very rude behaviour.

带领.zh: 班长带领全班同学把教室打扫得干干净净。
带领.en: The class monitor led the whole class in cleaning the classroom until it was spotless.

挪.zh: 这辆车挡住了出口，麻烦您把车往前挪一点。
挪.en: This car is blocking the exit; could you please move it forward a bit?

迫不及待.zh: 收到快递后，她迫不及待地拆开了包装。
迫不及待.en: As soon as the parcel arrived, she couldn't wait to tear open the packaging.

潜水.zh: 他在班级群里一直潜水，从来不发言。
潜水.en: He always lurks in the class group chat and never posts anything.

光荣.zh: 这位老师光荣退休，学生们为她举办了一场欢送会。
光荣.en: The teacher retired with honour, and her students held a farewell party for her.

违背.zh: 他不愿意违背自己的良心去说假话。
违背.en: He is unwilling to go against his conscience and tell lies.

挨.zh: 教室里的座位一个挨着一个，中间几乎没有空隙。
挨.en: The seats in the classroom are packed one next to another with almost no gaps in between.

遗产.zh: 他继承了父亲留下的一大笔遗产，却很快就挥霍光了。
遗产.en: He inherited a large fortune from his father but soon squandered it all.

瞬间.zh: 灯一关，整个房间瞬间变得一片漆黑。
瞬间.en: As soon as the light was switched off, the whole room instantly went pitch black.

正经.zh: 他平时爱开玩笑，可一上台演讲就变得很正经。
正经.en: He usually loves to joke, but as soon as he goes on stage to speak he becomes very serious.

圈套.zh: 这道题看起来简单，其实是老师故意设的圈套。
圈套.en: This question looks simple, but it is actually a trap the teacher set on purpose.

看待.zh: 他已经变了很多，你不要再用老眼光看待他了。
看待.en: He has changed a lot, so stop seeing him the way you used to.

惊奇.zh: 游客们惊奇地发现，这里的湖水竟然是粉红色的。
惊奇.en: The tourists were amazed to discover that the lake water here is actually pink.

人格.zh: 一个人的人格魅力往往比外表更吸引人。
人格.en: A person's strength of character is often more attractive than their looks.

珍贵.zh: 博物馆里展出了一批珍贵的文物，吸引了很多游客。
珍贵.en: The museum put a collection of precious cultural relics on display, attracting many visitors.

思维.zh: 这个设计打破了传统思维，让人眼前一亮。
思维.en: This design breaks with conventional thinking and is eye-opening.

先进.zh: 她连续三年被评为公司的先进工作者。
先进.en: She has been named the company's model worker three years in a row.

级别.zh: 他的工作级别比我高两级，工资也比我多。
级别.en: His job grade is two levels above mine, and he earns more than I do.

竞赛.zh: 学校每年都举办一次知识竞赛，每个班都要派代表参加。
竞赛.en: The school holds a general-knowledge quiz every year, and every class sends representatives.

真理.zh: 科学家们为了追求真理，从不害怕失败。
真理.en: In pursuit of the truth, scientists are never afraid of failure.

垫.zh: 椅子太硬了，你在上面垫个枕头吧。
垫.en: The chair is too hard; put a pillow on it.

革命.zh: 蒸汽机的发明引发了第一次工业革命。
革命.en: The invention of the steam engine triggered the first Industrial Revolution.

引导.zh: 工作人员引导观众有序地进入体育馆。
引导.en: The staff guided the audience into the stadium in an orderly way.

岩石.zh: 登山者小心地沿着陡峭的岩石往上爬。
岩石.en: The climbers carefully made their way up the steep rocks.

迷惑.zh: 魔术师用一些小动作迷惑观众，让大家看不出破绽。
迷惑.en: The magician uses small movements to mislead the audience so nobody can spot the trick.

干涉.zh: 这是我们两个人之间的事，请你不要干涉。
干涉.en: This is between the two of us, so please don't interfere.

学位.zh: 他一边工作一边读书，终于拿到了博士学位。
学位.en: He studied while working and finally obtained his doctoral degree.

嫌.zh: 她嫌这家饭馆太吵，拉着我换了一家。
嫌.en: She found this restaurant too noisy and dragged me off to a different one.

嫌疑.zh: 那个员工有偷公司资料的嫌疑，已经被停职调查。
嫌疑.en: That employee is suspected of stealing company data and has been suspended pending investigation.

交叉.zh: 老师让我们把双手交叉放在胸前，安静地坐好。
交叉.en: The teacher told us to cross our arms over our chests and sit quietly.

纳闷儿.zh: 这么晚了那家商店还开着门，大家都有点纳闷儿。
纳闷儿.en: That shop is still open so late, and everyone is a bit puzzled.

元首.zh: 这位国家元首访问期间参观了当地的一所大学。
元首.en: During the visit, the head of state toured a local university.

人间.zh: 她用自己的善良让大家感受到了人间的温暖。
人间.en: Through her kindness she let everyone feel the warmth of the human world.

本能.zh: 刚出生的小海龟凭着本能爬向大海。
本能.en: Newly hatched sea turtles crawl towards the sea by instinct.

修复.zh: 这个软件可以帮你修复手机系统的一些错误。
修复.en: This software can help you fix some errors in your phone's system.

认定.zh: 经过调查，专家认定这次火灾是由电线老化引起的。
认定.en: After investigation, experts determined that the fire was caused by ageing wiring.

拳头.zh: 他紧紧地握着拳头，努力让自己冷静下来。
拳头.en: He clenched his fists tightly, trying to calm himself down.

抵达.zh: 经过三天的长途旅行，我们终于抵达了目的地。
抵达.en: After three days of long-distance travel, we finally reached our destination.

一流.zh: 她是一位一流的厨师，做的菜在城里很有名。
一流.en: She is a first-class chef whose dishes are famous throughout the city.

悲哀.zh: 看到那片美丽的森林被砍光，他心里感到一阵悲哀。
悲哀.en: Seeing that beautiful forest cut down, he felt a wave of sorrow.

坑.zh: 这家店卖的东西又贵又差，简直是在坑顾客。
坑.en: This shop sells things that are both expensive and poor quality; it is simply cheating customers.

发觉.zh: 他看书看得太入迷，没发觉天已经黑了。
发觉.en: He was so absorbed in his book that he didn't realise it had already got dark.

居住.zh: 这个小岛上居住着不到一百户人家。
居住.en: Fewer than a hundred households live on this small island.

呈现.zh: 这份报告用图表把数据清楚地呈现了出来。
呈现.en: This report presents the data clearly using charts.

别墅.zh: 这位明星在郊区有一座带游泳池的别墅。
别墅.en: This celebrity has a villa with a swimming pool in the suburbs.

识别.zh: 这款手机可以通过指纹识别主人的身份。
识别.en: This phone can identify its owner by fingerprint.

等候.zh: 车站的大厅里坐满了等候上车的旅客。
等候.en: The station hall was full of passengers waiting to board.

失误.zh: 由于工作人员的失误，我的名字被印错了。
失误.en: Because of a staff error, my name was printed wrongly.

和解.zh: 经过律师调解，两家公司最终选择了和解。
和解.en: After mediation by lawyers, the two companies finally chose to settle.

元素.zh: 氧是地壳中含量最多的化学元素。
元素.en: Oxygen is the most abundant chemical element in the Earth's crust.

贪婪.zh: 他太贪婪了，赚了那么多钱还嫌不够。
贪婪.en: He is too greedy; even after earning so much money he still thinks it's not enough.

传达.zh: 这幅画通过明亮的颜色传达出一种快乐的情绪。
传达.en: This painting conveys a joyful mood through its bright colours.

镇定.zh: 面试时，她努力让自己保持镇定，回答了所有问题。
镇定.en: In the interview she tried hard to stay calm and answered every question.

清晰.zh: 他的发音很清晰，每个字都让人听得明明白白。
清晰.en: His pronunciation is very clear; every word can be understood perfectly.

捏.zh: 妈妈轻轻捏了一下女儿的脸蛋。
捏.en: Mum gently pinched her daughter's cheek.

麻醉.zh: 麻醉过后，伤口开始隐隐作痛。
麻醉.en: Once the anaesthetic wore off, the wound began to ache.

细菌.zh: 抹布用久了会滋生大量细菌，要经常更换。
细菌.en: Dishcloths breed lots of bacteria after long use, so change them often.

眼光.zh: 这位投资人很有眼光，十年前就看好了这家公司。
眼光.en: This investor has real vision; he believed in this company ten years ago.

无知.zh: 我们不应该嘲笑别人的无知，而应该耐心解释。
无知.en: We shouldn't laugh at other people's ignorance; we should explain patiently.

仪器.zh: 医生用一台专门的仪器检查了我的眼睛。
仪器.en: The doctor examined my eyes with a special instrument.

杰出.zh: 他为中国足球的发展做出了杰出的贡献。
杰出.en: He made an outstanding contribution to the development of Chinese football.

放大.zh: 这台显微镜能把物体放大一千倍。
放大.en: This microscope can magnify objects a thousand times.

往常.zh: 和往常一样，他吃完晚饭就去公园散步。
往常.en: As usual, he went for a walk in the park after dinner.

亲热.zh: 小狗一见到主人就亲热地扑了上去。
亲热.en: As soon as the puppy saw its owner, it leapt on him affectionately.

风趣.zh: 他是个风趣的人，有他在的地方总是充满笑声。
风趣.en: He is a witty person; wherever he is, there is always laughter.

诞生.zh: 随着互联网的发展，很多新职业诞生了。
诞生.en: With the development of the internet, many new professions have come into being.

忠实.zh: 这部电影忠实地还原了原著小说的故事。
忠实.en: This film faithfully recreates the story of the original novel.

符号.zh: 加号和减号是数学中最常用的符号。
符号.en: The plus and minus signs are the most commonly used symbols in maths.

指定.zh: 老师指定他担任这次活动的负责人。
指定.en: The teacher appointed him to be in charge of this event.

以便.zh: 把重要的文件放在桌上，以便明天一早就能找到。
以便.en: Put the important documents on the desk so that you can find them first thing tomorrow.

鉴定.zh: 经过专家鉴定，这栋老楼已经成了危房，居民必须马上搬走。
鉴定.en: Experts assessed the old building as unsafe, so the residents must move out immediately.

蹦.zh: 小兔子从笼子里蹦了出来，在草地上到处跑。
蹦.en: The little rabbit hopped out of its cage and ran all over the grass.

纤维.zh: 这件衬衫是用天然纤维做的，穿着很舒服。
纤维.en: This shirt is made of natural fibres and is very comfortable to wear.

盗窃.zh: 为了防止盗窃，博物馆安装了新的监控系统。
盗窃.en: To prevent theft, the museum installed a new surveillance system.

推销.zh: 一个年轻人敲开我家的门，向我推销保险。
推销.en: A young man knocked on my door and tried to sell me insurance.

宣誓.zh: 运动员代表在开幕式上宣誓，保证公平比赛。
宣誓.en: At the opening ceremony, the athletes' representative took an oath to compete fairly.

需求.zh: 随着人口老龄化，社会对护理人员的需求越来越大。
需求.en: As the population ages, society's demand for carers keeps growing.

雷达.zh: 交警用测速雷达发现那辆车开得太快了。
雷达.en: The traffic police used a speed radar to find that the car was going too fast.

跪.zh: 小朋友跪在沙发上，扒着窗台往外看。
跪.en: The child knelt on the sofa, holding onto the windowsill to look outside.

终身.zh: 这位老教授获得了学会颁发的终身成就奖。
终身.en: The old professor received the society's lifetime achievement award.

煎.zh: 这种中药需要用小火煎半个小时。
煎.en: This Chinese herbal medicine needs to be decocted over a low heat for half an hour.

捣乱.zh: 小猫总在我工作的时候跳上键盘捣乱。
捣乱.en: The kitten always jumps on the keyboard and makes trouble while I'm working.

哄.zh: 他买了一束花，想哄女朋友开心。
哄.en: He bought a bunch of flowers, hoping to cheer up his girlfriend.

福利.zh: 政府提高了退休老人的福利待遇。
福利.en: The government has raised the welfare benefits of retired people.

驱逐.zh: 他的签证过期多年，最后被驱逐出境。
驱逐.en: His visa had expired years earlier, and he was eventually deported.

牵扯.zh: 我不想被牵扯进他们两个人的争吵中。
牵扯.en: I don't want to be dragged into the quarrel between the two of them.

探索.zh: 孩子天生喜欢探索周围的世界。
探索.en: Children are born loving to explore the world around them.

循环.zh: 这首歌太好听了，我单曲循环了一整天。
循环.en: This song is so good that I played it on repeat all day.

财务.zh: 公司每个月底都要整理一次财务报表。
财务.en: At the end of every month the company has to prepare its financial statements.

局势.zh: 下了这步棋以后，局势对白方越来越不利。
局势.en: After this move, the position became more and more unfavourable for White.

运行.zh: 我的电脑同时运行太多程序，就会变得很慢。
运行.en: When my computer runs too many programs at once, it becomes very slow.

终止.zh: 两家公司终止了长达十年的合作关系。
终止.en: The two companies ended a partnership that had lasted ten years.

模样.zh: 女儿长大后，越来越像她妈妈年轻时的模样。
模样.en: As the daughter grows up, she looks more and more like her mother did when young.

峡谷.zh: 我们站在桥上，往下看是深不见底的峡谷。
峡谷.en: We stood on the bridge, looking down into a gorge so deep we couldn't see the bottom.

频率.zh: 最近他咳嗽的频率越来越高，最好去医院看看。
频率.en: Recently he has been coughing more and more often; he'd better see a doctor.

登陆.zh: 这款新手机下个月将正式登陆中国市场。
登陆.en: This new phone will officially launch in the Chinese market next month.

含义.zh: 在中国，红色有吉祥、喜庆的含义。
含义.en: In China, the colour red carries connotations of good luck and celebration.

资助.zh: 在一家基金会的资助下，他完成了这项研究。
资助.en: With funding from a foundation, he completed this research.

挖掘.zh: 考古队在这里挖掘出了许多古代的陶器。
挖掘.en: The archaeological team dug up many ancient pottery vessels here.

拖延.zh: 他有拖延的坏习惯，作业总是最后一天才写。
拖延.en: He has a bad habit of procrastinating and always does his homework on the last day.

优先.zh: 应聘这个职位，会说日语的人将被优先录用。
优先.en: For this position, applicants who speak Japanese will be given priority in hiring.

以往.zh: 和以往不同，这次他没有迟到。
以往.en: Unlike in the past, this time he wasn't late.

争夺.zh: 两只小狗为了争夺一根骨头，叫个不停。
争夺.en: The two puppies kept barking as they fought over a bone.

赋予.zh: 艺术家赋予了这些旧瓶子新的生命。
赋予.en: The artist gave these old bottles a new life.

回避.zh: 记者问到他的私生活时，他巧妙地回避了。
回避.en: When reporters asked about his private life, he cleverly dodged the question.

警惕.zh: 家长要提高警惕，不要让孩子独自去河边玩。
警惕.en: Parents should be on their guard and not let children play by the river alone.

妥协.zh: 在原则问题上，他从来不肯妥协。
妥协.en: On matters of principle, he never compromises.

精确.zh: 这台电子秤可以精确到零点一克，很适合做蛋糕时用。
精确.en: This digital scale is precise to 0.1 grams, which makes it ideal for baking.

钞票.zh: 银行用机器清点钞票，又快又准。
钞票.en: Banks use machines to count banknotes quickly and accurately.

演绎.zh: 这首老歌被一位年轻歌手重新演绎，又火了起来。
演绎.en: This old song was reinterpreted by a young singer and became popular again.

依赖.zh: 现在很多人对手机产生了严重的依赖。
依赖.en: Nowadays many people have become seriously dependent on their phones.

上瘾.zh: 咖啡喝多了会上瘾，一天不喝就没精神。
上瘾.en: Drink too much coffee and you get hooked; a day without it leaves you sluggish.

电源.zh: 笔记本电脑没电了，附近有没有电源可以充电？
电源.en: My laptop is out of battery; is there a power outlet nearby where I can charge it?

气色.zh: 她病了一个月，气色很差，人也瘦了不少。
气色.en: She has been ill for a month; her complexion is poor and she has lost a lot of weight.

意图.zh: 从他的眼神里，我看出了他想离开的意图。
意图.en: From his eyes, I could see his intention to leave.

坚定.zh: 面对诱惑，他态度坚定，一口拒绝了。
坚定.en: Faced with temptation, he stood firm and refused outright.

倾听.zh: 当朋友难过时，我们最需要做的就是静静地倾听。
倾听.en: When a friend is sad, what we most need to do is listen quietly.

玩弄.zh: 那个孩子坐在角落里，低着头玩弄手里的铅笔。
玩弄.en: The child sat in the corner, head down, toying with the pencil in his hand.

新郎.zh: 婚礼上，新郎紧张得把戒指掉在了地上。
新郎.en: At the wedding, the groom was so nervous he dropped the ring on the floor.

童话.zh: 下雪后的小镇美得像童话世界一样。
童话.en: After the snow, the little town was as beautiful as a fairy-tale world.

吩咐.zh: 经理吩咐秘书把会议推迟到下午三点。
吩咐.en: The manager told the secretary to postpone the meeting to 3 p.m.

高尚.zh: 他品德高尚，常常把自己的工资捐给有需要的人。
高尚.en: He is a man of noble character who often donates his salary to people in need.

偏见.zh: 很多人对胖人存在偏见，认为他们很懒。
偏见.en: Many people are prejudiced against overweight people, thinking they are lazy.

保管.zh: 你按我说的方法做，保管不会出错。
保管.en: Do it the way I told you, and you certainly won't go wrong.

解散.zh: 由于缺少经费，学校的足球队被迫解散。
解散.en: Due to a lack of funding, the school football team was forced to disband.

焦点.zh: 拍照时，要先把焦点对准人物的脸。
焦点.en: When taking photos, first set the focus on the person's face.

无耻.zh: 他借了钱不还，还到处说别人欠他钱，真是太无耻了。
无耻.en: He borrowed money and didn't pay it back, then went around saying others owed him; how shameless.

战略.zh: 下棋不能只看眼前一步，要有长远的战略眼光。
战略.en: In chess you can't just look one move ahead; you need a long-term strategic view.

仍旧.zh: 多年过去了，这家小店的味道仍旧没变。
仍旧.en: Many years have passed, yet the food at this little shop still tastes the same.

首要.zh: 对于新手司机来说，安全是首要的。
首要.en: For new drivers, safety is of primary importance.

脉搏.zh: 跑完步后，他的脉搏跳得非常快。
脉搏.en: After running, his pulse was beating very fast.

封闭.zh: 长期生活在封闭的环境里，人容易变得孤独。
封闭.en: Living in a closed-off environment for a long time can easily make people lonely.

走私.zh: 这艘渔船被发现利用夜色走私香烟。
走私.en: This fishing boat was found to be smuggling cigarettes under cover of night.

出路.zh: 村里的年轻人觉得种地没有出路，纷纷去城里打工。
出路.en: The young people in the village feel that farming has no future, so one after another they go to work in the city.

掏.zh: 他总爱用手指掏耳朵，医生说这样对耳朵不好。
掏.en: He always picks his ears with his finger, which the doctor says is bad for them.

动脉.zh: 医生说，他的心脏动脉有一处堵塞，需要做手术。
动脉.en: The doctor said one of his heart's arteries is blocked and he needs an operation.

目睹.zh: 几位路人目睹了事故的全过程，主动向交警说明情况。
目睹.en: Several passers-by witnessed the whole accident and volunteered to explain what happened to the traffic police.

恶化.zh: 由于工厂随意排放污水，这条河的水质不断恶化。
恶化.en: Because factories discharge waste water at will, the river's water quality keeps getting worse.

阻碍.zh: 一棵倒下的大树阻碍了交通，车辆排起了长队。
阻碍.en: A fallen tree blocked traffic, and cars formed long queues.

监督.zh: 欢迎广大顾客对我们的服务进行监督。
监督.en: We welcome all customers to monitor the quality of our service.

幼稚.zh: 他为了一块糖跟妹妹吵架，真是太幼稚了。
幼稚.en: He argued with his little sister over a piece of candy; that's really childish.

宪法.zh: 每个公民都应该遵守宪法和法律。
宪法.en: Every citizen should abide by the constitution and the law.

面子.zh: 看在老朋友的面子上，这次就原谅他吧。
面子.en: For the sake of an old friend, let's forgive him this time.

激励.zh: 公司设立了奖金制度，以激励员工多提建议。
激励.en: The company set up a bonus system to motivate employees to make more suggestions.

歧视.zh: 这家公司因为年龄歧视被应聘者告上了法庭。
歧视.en: This company was taken to court by a job applicant for age discrimination.

极限.zh: 这座桥的承重已经接近极限，大卡车不能再通过。
极限.en: The load on this bridge is already close to its limit, so large trucks can no longer cross.

严厉.zh: 经理严厉地批评了经常迟到的员工。
严厉.en: The manager sternly criticised the employee who was often late.

特定.zh: 这个词只在特定的场合使用，平时说话很少用到。
特定.en: This word is only used on particular occasions and rarely comes up in everyday speech.

港口.zh: 货物从港口装上船，一个月后运到了欧洲。
港口.en: The goods were loaded onto a ship at the port and reached Europe a month later.

曝光.zh: 这张照片曝光过度，整个画面都发白了。
曝光.en: This photo is overexposed; the whole picture has turned white.

扑.zh: 一阵香味扑面而来，原来隔壁在烤面包。
扑.en: A wave of fragrance hit me in the face; it turned out the neighbours were baking bread.

引用.zh: 写论文时引用别人的观点，一定要注明出处。
引用.en: When you quote other people's views in a paper, you must cite the source.

纯洁.zh: 在很多文化里，白色象征着纯洁。
纯洁.en: In many cultures, white symbolises purity.

古董.zh: 这张桌子是一件古董，已经有两百多年的历史了。
古董.en: This table is an antique more than two hundred years old.

知觉.zh: 打了麻药以后，病人的腿就没有知觉了。
知觉.en: After the anaesthetic was given, the patient had no feeling in his leg.

压抑.zh: 办公室里没有窗户，让人觉得很压抑。
压抑.en: The office has no windows, which makes it feel very oppressive.

流浪.zh: 他年轻时背着吉他在各地流浪，靠唱歌为生。
流浪.en: When he was young he wandered from place to place with his guitar, making a living by singing.

进化.zh: 鸟类的翅膀是经过几百万年慢慢进化而成的。
进化.en: Birds' wings slowly evolved over millions of years.

发行.zh: 邮局明年将发行一套熊猫纪念邮票。
发行.en: Next year the post office will issue a set of commemorative panda stamps.

遥远.zh: 那颗星星离地球非常遥远，它的光要走几千年才能到达。
遥远.en: That star is extremely far from Earth; its light takes thousands of years to arrive.

挽回.zh: 他真诚地道歉，希望能挽回女朋友的心。
挽回.en: He apologised sincerely, hoping to win back his girlfriend's heart.

途径.zh: 你可以通过官方网站或电话两种途径报名。
途径.en: You can sign up through either of two channels: the official website or by phone.

着手.zh: 毕业前一年，他就开始着手写论文了。
着手.en: A year before graduating, he had already set about writing his thesis.

炫耀.zh: 她把考了满分的试卷拿给每个人看，到处炫耀。
炫耀.en: She showed her perfect-score exam paper to everyone, showing off everywhere.

唠叨.zh: 爷爷年纪大了，一件事总要唠叨好几遍。
唠叨.en: Grandpa is getting old and always goes on about the same thing several times.

目光.zh: 所有人的目光都集中在了那个迟到的人身上。
目光.en: Everyone's eyes were fixed on the person who arrived late.

摇摆.zh: 他在两个工作机会之间摇摆不定，迟迟做不了决定。
摇摆.en: He wavered between two job offers and kept putting off a decision.

镇静.zh: 医生给他打了一针镇静剂，他才慢慢睡着了。
镇静.en: The doctor gave him a sedative injection, and only then did he slowly fall asleep.

处置.zh: 这个学生考试作弊，学校决定严肃处置。
处置.en: This student cheated in an exam, and the school decided to deal with it severely.

名誉.zh: 这些假新闻严重损害了他的名誉。
名誉.en: This fake news has seriously damaged his reputation.

保障.zh: 完善的社会保障制度能让老人安享晚年。
保障.en: A sound social security system lets older people live out their later years in peace.

解剖.zh: 生物课上，我们第一次解剖了一只青蛙。
解剖.en: In biology class, we dissected a frog for the first time.

腐烂.zh: 落在地上的树叶慢慢腐烂，变成了肥料。
腐烂.en: The leaves on the ground slowly rot and become fertiliser.

统计.zh: 据统计，这个城市每天产生上万吨垃圾。
统计.en: According to statistics, this city produces over ten thousand tonnes of rubbish a day.

生理.zh: 饿了想吃东西，困了想睡觉，这些都是正常的生理需要。
生理.en: Wanting to eat when hungry and sleep when tired are normal physiological needs.

束.zh: 一束阳光从窗户照进来，正好落在书桌上。
束.en: A beam of sunlight shone through the window and fell right on the desk.

容器.zh: 用微波炉加热食物时，不能使用金属容器。
容器.en: When heating food in a microwave, you must not use metal containers.

刑事.zh: 他酒后驾车撞伤了人，要承担刑事责任。
刑事.en: He injured someone while drink-driving and must bear criminal liability.

融化.zh: 冰淇淋拿在手里没多久就融化了。
融化.en: The ice cream melted not long after I picked it up.

空白.zh: 这项研究填补了国内在这个领域的空白。
空白.en: This research fills a gap in the country's work in this field.

捞.zh: 他想趁机捞一笔钱，结果被老板发现了。
捞.en: He tried to take the chance to grab some money for himself, but his boss found out.

打猎.zh: 秋天一到，村里的男人们就带着狗上山打猎。
打猎.en: As soon as autumn comes, the village men take their dogs up the mountain to hunt.

跨.zh: 这座大桥跨过长江，把两座城市连了起来。
跨.en: This great bridge spans the Yangtze River and links two cities.

祖国.zh: 每当听到国歌响起，他都为自己的祖国感到骄傲。
祖国.en: Whenever he hears the national anthem, he feels proud of his motherland.

奉献.zh: 很多志愿者在节假日默默奉献，帮助需要帮助的人。
奉献.en: Many volunteers quietly give their time during holidays to help people in need.

场所.zh: 在商场、车站等公共场所，请不要吸烟。
场所.en: Please don't smoke in public places such as shopping malls and stations.

要命.zh: 这牙疼起来真要命，我一晚上都没睡着。
要命.en: This toothache is killing me; I didn't sleep all night.

精心.zh: 护士们精心照顾这位老人，他很快就恢复了健康。
精心.en: The nurses looked after the old man with great care, and he soon recovered.

床单.zh: 孩子把牛奶洒在了床上，床单全湿了。
床单.en: The child spilled milk on the bed and the sheet got soaked.

固执.zh: 爷爷固执地认为，生病了多喝热水就能好。
固执.en: Grandpa stubbornly believes that drinking lots of hot water will cure any illness.

冷酷.zh: 他表面上冷酷无情，其实心里很善良。
冷酷.en: On the surface he seems cold and heartless, but deep down he is very kind.

榜样.zh: 哥哥学习很努力，是我学习的榜样。
榜样.en: My older brother studies very hard and is my role model.

和谐.zh: 这幅画的颜色搭配得很和谐，看起来很舒服。
和谐.en: The colours in this painting go together harmoniously and are pleasant to look at.

勉强.zh: 他的成绩勉强及格，差一点就没通过。
勉强.en: His score barely passed; he very nearly failed.

纠正.zh: 如果发现报道里有错误，我们会及时纠正。
纠正.en: If we find any errors in the report, we will correct them promptly.

条款.zh: 这份保险的条款里写得很清楚，自然灾害不在赔偿范围内。
条款.en: The terms of this insurance clearly state that natural disasters are not covered.

关照.zh: 我出国这段时间，请你帮我关照一下我的父母。
关照.en: While I'm abroad, please keep an eye on my parents for me.

损坏.zh: 借来的书如果损坏了，要按价赔偿。
损坏.en: If a borrowed book is damaged, you must pay for it at its value.

包装.zh: 这家公司很会包装自己的产品，所以卖得特别好。
包装.en: This company is very good at packaging its products, so they sell especially well.

中断.zh: 由于网络中断，视频会议只好暂停。
中断.en: Because the internet connection was cut off, the video meeting had to be paused.

英勇.zh: 这部电影讲述了一名飞行员英勇救人的故事。
英勇.en: This film tells the story of a pilot who heroically saved people.

粒.zh: 农民辛苦种出的每一粒米都来之不易。
粒.en: Every grain of rice that farmers grow through hard work does not come easily.

番.zh: 他把房间重新布置了一番，看起来焕然一新。
番.en: He rearranged the room, and it looks brand new.

液体.zh: 水在零度以下会从液体变成固体。
液体.en: Below zero degrees, water turns from a liquid into a solid.

担保.zh: 他向银行贷款时，请父亲做了担保人。
担保.en: When he took out a bank loan, he asked his father to be his guarantor.

报答.zh: 那位老人救过他的命，他一直想找机会报答。
报答.en: That old man once saved his life, and he has always wanted a chance to repay him.

认可.zh: 这所大学的学历在国外也是被认可的。
认可.en: Degrees from this university are recognised abroad as well.

势力.zh: 这个家族在当地很有势力，没人敢得罪他们。
势力.en: This family is very powerful locally; nobody dares to cross them.

资产.zh: 这套房子是他们家最主要的资产。
资产.en: This flat is their family's main asset.

占领.zh: 周末一到，公园的草地就被野餐的家庭占领了。
占领.en: As soon as the weekend comes, the park lawns are taken over by picnicking families.

饥饿.zh: 世界上仍有很多人在忍受饥饿。
饥饿.en: There are still many people in the world suffering from hunger.

销毁.zh: 警方当众销毁了收缴的假药。
销毁.en: The police publicly destroyed the confiscated fake medicine.

注视.zh: 台下的观众都在注视着这位年轻的钢琴家。
注视.en: The audience below the stage were all watching the young pianist intently.

财政.zh: 这个小镇财政困难，连路灯都修不起。
财政.en: This small town is in financial difficulty and can't even afford to repair its streetlights.

上级.zh: 他刚升职，就成了以前同事的上级。
上级.en: He was just promoted and became the boss of his former colleagues.

缺陷.zh: 这个计划有一个明显的缺陷：没有考虑成本。
缺陷.en: This plan has an obvious flaw: it doesn't consider costs.

磕.zh: 他把鸡蛋在碗边轻轻一磕，蛋壳就裂开了。
磕.en: He tapped the egg gently on the edge of the bowl, and the shell cracked open.

憋.zh: 电影院里人太多，空气不流通，憋得我喘不过气来。
憋.en: The cinema was so crowded and stuffy that I felt stifled and could hardly breathe.

差别.zh: 同样是员工，公司不应该搞差别待遇。
差别.en: They are all employees, so the company shouldn't treat them differently.

制止.zh: 如果不及时制止，这种浪费现象会越来越严重。
制止.en: If it isn't stopped in time, this kind of waste will only get worse.

依旧.zh: 多年不见，王老师风采依旧，一点儿也不显老。
依旧.en: We haven't seen Teacher Wang in years, but she is as elegant as ever and doesn't look any older.

部位.zh: 这种按摩方法主要针对颈部和肩膀这两个部位。
部位.en: This massage technique mainly targets two areas: the neck and the shoulders.

言论.zh: 这位明星因为发表了不当言论，向公众道歉。
言论.en: The celebrity apologised to the public for making inappropriate remarks.

活该.zh: 他考试前天天玩游戏，没考好也是活该。
活该.en: He played games every day before the exam, so it serves him right that he did badly.

恰当.zh: 在正式场合穿运动服显得不太恰当。
恰当.en: Wearing sportswear on a formal occasion seems rather inappropriate.

脂肪.zh: 多运动可以帮助燃烧身体里多余的脂肪。
脂肪.en: Exercising more can help burn excess fat in the body.

磁带.zh: 我在抽屉里找到了一盘九十年代的英语听力磁带。
磁带.en: I found an English listening cassette from the nineties in the drawer.

塌.zh: 这个蛋糕刚从烤箱里拿出来就塌了下去。
塌.en: This cake collapsed as soon as it came out of the oven.

埋葬.zh: 小男孩把死去的小鸟埋葬在花园的树下。
埋葬.en: The little boy buried the dead bird under the tree in the garden.

占据.zh: 在他的心中，家庭始终占据着最重要的位置。
占据.en: In his heart, family has always held the most important place.

华丽.zh: 这篇文章辞藻华丽，可是内容很空洞。
华丽.en: This essay is full of flowery language, but its content is hollow.

答复.zh: 这件事我得跟家人商量一下，明天再给你一个明确的答复。
答复.en: I need to talk this over with my family; I'll give you a definite answer tomorrow.

疤.zh: 伤口愈合以后，他的膝盖上留下了一个疤。
疤.en: After the wound healed, it left a scar on his knee.

横.zh: 他在纸上画了一条横线，把两部分内容分开。
横.en: He drew a horizontal line on the paper to separate the two parts.

岗位.zh: 这家工厂今年新增了两百个工作岗位。
岗位.en: This factory added two hundred new jobs this year.

前提.zh: 在保证质量的前提下，我们要尽量降低成本。
前提.en: On the precondition that quality is guaranteed, we should cut costs as much as possible.

大伙儿.zh: 饭菜都做好了，大伙儿快趁热来吃吧！
大伙儿.en: The food is ready, everyone; come and eat it while it's hot!

光芒.zh: 她的眼睛里闪着自信的光芒。
光芒.en: Her eyes shone with the light of confidence.

粉色.zh: 春天一到，满树的樱花开成了一片粉色。
粉色.en: When spring arrives, the cherry trees burst into a sea of pink blossom.

揭露.zh: 这部电影揭露了网络诈骗分子的各种手段。
揭露.en: This film exposes the various tricks used by online scammers.

近来.zh: 近来他工作特别忙，经常很晚才回家。
近来.en: Lately he has been especially busy at work and often gets home very late.

比方.zh: 比方说，你可以每天早上读半小时中文。
比方.en: For example, you could read Chinese for half an hour every morning.

屈服.zh: 她没有向父母的压力屈服，坚持选择了自己喜欢的专业。
屈服.en: She didn't give in to her parents' pressure and insisted on choosing the major she liked.

膜.zh: 煮好的牛奶放凉后，表面会结一层薄薄的膜。
膜.en: When boiled milk cools, a thin skin forms on its surface.

诈骗.zh: 那个人冒充银行工作人员，诈骗了老人五万块钱。
诈骗.en: That man posed as a bank employee and swindled an old person out of fifty thousand yuan.

是非.zh: 她不喜欢在背后议论别人的是非。
是非.en: She doesn't like to gossip about other people behind their backs.

崭新.zh: 搬进崭新的教学楼后，同学们都很兴奋。
崭新.en: After moving into the brand-new teaching building, the students were all excited.

亦.zh: 此书内容丰富，语言亦十分生动。
亦.en: This book is rich in content, and its language is also very lively.

昂贵.zh: 因为一次小小的失误，公司付出了昂贵的代价。
昂贵.en: Because of one small slip, the company paid a heavy price.

彩票.zh: 听说隔壁的老王中了彩票，一下子成了有钱人。
彩票.en: I heard old Wang next door won the lottery and became rich overnight.

履行.zh: 既然答应了别人，就要履行自己的诺言。
履行.en: Since you made someone a promise, you must keep it.

沉重.zh: 听到这个坏消息，大家的心情都很沉重。
沉重.en: Hearing this bad news, everyone felt heavy-hearted.

家属.zh: 公司组织员工和家属一起去海边度假。
家属.en: The company organised a seaside holiday for employees and their families.

回收.zh: 很多超市都设置了旧电池回收箱。
回收.en: Many supermarkets have set up recycling bins for used batteries.

化验.zh: 这瓶水的质量要送到实验室化验后才知道。
化验.en: We won't know the quality of this bottle of water until it has been tested in a lab.

蚂蚁.zh: 下雨之前，常常能看到蚂蚁忙着搬家。
蚂蚁.en: Before it rains, you can often see ants busily moving house.

演习.zh: 为了应对地震，这个城市每年都会举行一次大型演习。
演习.en: To prepare for earthquakes, this city holds a large-scale drill every year.

束缚.zh: 这条裙子太紧了，穿着像被束缚住一样，很不自在。
束缚.en: This skirt is too tight; wearing it feels like being tied up, and it's very uncomfortable.

僵硬.zh: 他第一次上台演出，动作显得有点儿僵硬。
僵硬.en: It was his first time performing on stage, and his movements looked a bit stiff.

忧郁.zh: 这首歌的旋律很忧郁，让人听了想哭。
忧郁.en: This song's melody is so melancholy that it makes you want to cry.

平凡.zh: 她只是一个平凡的家庭主妇，却把三个孩子都培养成了医生。
平凡.en: She is just an ordinary housewife, yet she raised all three of her children to become doctors.

全力以赴.zh: 为了通过下个月的考试，他每天都全力以赴地复习。
全力以赴.en: To pass next month's exam, he goes all out revising every day.

黎明.zh: 渔民们黎明前就出海了，中午才回来。
黎明.en: The fishermen went out to sea before dawn and didn't come back until noon.

顽固.zh: 他的咳嗽十分顽固，吃了一个月药还没好。
顽固.en: His cough is very persistent; he has taken medicine for a month and it still isn't better.

贩卖.zh: 这个团伙因为非法贩卖野生动物被抓了。
贩卖.en: This gang was caught illegally trafficking wild animals.

瘫痪.zh: 黑客的攻击使公司的电脑系统瘫痪了好几个小时。
瘫痪.en: The hacker attack paralysed the company's computer system for several hours.

泼.zh: 他正兴致勃勃地说着计划，朋友却给他泼了一盆冷水。
泼.en: He was excitedly describing his plan when his friend poured cold water on it.

比喻.zh: 这首诗用了很多生动的比喻，读起来很有意思。
比喻.en: This poem uses many vivid metaphors and is very interesting to read.

免得.zh: 你到了以后给家里打个电话，免得父母担心。
免得.en: Call home when you arrive so your parents don't worry.

传单.zh: 一位年轻人在地铁口给路人发健身房的宣传单。
传单.en: A young man was handing out gym flyers to passers-by at the subway entrance.

皇帝.zh: 《皇帝的新装》是一个很有名的童话故事。
皇帝.en: The Emperor's New Clothes is a very famous fairy tale.

协调.zh: 这次活动涉及好几个部门，需要有人负责协调。
协调.en: This event involves several departments, so someone needs to be in charge of coordinating.

万分.zh: 得知孩子在山里走失，父母万分焦急。
万分.en: On learning that their child was lost in the mountains, the parents were extremely anxious.

跟随.zh: 她十八岁就跟随父亲学习做生意。
跟随.en: At eighteen she began learning business by following her father.

罕见.zh: 这种蓝色的蝴蝶非常罕见，很多人从来没见过。
罕见.en: This blue butterfly is very rare; many people have never seen one.

缘故.zh: 可能是喝了咖啡的缘故，我昨晚一点儿都不困。
缘故.en: Probably because I drank coffee, I wasn't sleepy at all last night.

起初.zh: 起初大家都不看好这个项目，没想到它最后大获成功。
起初.en: At first nobody thought much of this project, but unexpectedly it was a huge success in the end.

安宁.zh: 楼上天天装修，吵得我们不得安宁。
安宁.en: The flat upstairs is being renovated every day, and the noise gives us no peace.

兑现.zh: 这张支票可以在任何一家银行兑现。
兑现.en: This cheque can be cashed at any bank.

为难.zh: 他已经尽力了，你就别再为难他了。
为难.en: He has already done his best, so stop making things difficult for him.

腐败.zh: 这家公司的管理层很腐败，员工们都很失望。
腐败.en: The management of this company is very corrupt, and the employees are all disappointed.

毫米.zh: 今天这场大雨的降水量超过了五十毫米。
毫米.en: Today's heavy rain brought more than fifty millimetres of rainfall.

当面.zh: 这份礼物我想当面交给她，不想寄过去。
当面.en: I want to give her this present in person, not post it.

当场.zh: 那个小偷刚伸手，就被保安当场抓住了。
当场.en: The thief had just reached out his hand when security caught him on the spot.

片刻.zh: 他沉默了片刻，然后才回答我的问题。
片刻.en: He was silent for a moment before answering my question.

油漆.zh: 这张旧桌子刷上新油漆以后，看起来跟新的一样。
油漆.en: After a fresh coat of paint, this old table looks as good as new.

方位.zh: 这个城市的路都是斜的，我刚来时总搞不清方位。
方位.en: The roads in this city all run at angles, and when I first arrived I could never get my bearings.

往事.zh: 看着这些老照片，许多往事又浮现在眼前。
往事.en: Looking at these old photos, many past events came back before my eyes.

分辨.zh: 色盲的人很难分辨红色和绿色。
分辨.en: Colour-blind people find it hard to tell red from green.

难得.zh: 他平时工作很忙，今天难得有空陪孩子去公园。
难得.en: He is usually very busy at work; today he has a rare chance to take the children to the park.

溅.zh: 她往锅里放鱼的时候，热油溅到了手上。
溅.en: When she put the fish into the wok, hot oil spattered onto her hand.

恩怨.zh: 比赛结束后，两个人握了握手，把过去的恩怨都放下了。
恩怨.en: After the match, the two shook hands and put their old grudges behind them.

功劳.zh: 孩子能考上大学，妈妈的功劳最大。
功劳.en: The mother deserves the most credit for her child getting into university.

行政.zh: 她负责公司的行政管理，每天要处理很多杂事。
行政.en: She is in charge of the company's administration and has to handle lots of odd jobs every day.

安置.zh: 洪水过后，受灾的村民被安置在附近的学校里。
安置.en: After the flood, the affected villagers were housed in a nearby school.

原告.zh: 在这起案件中，原告要求被告赔偿十万元。
原告.en: In this case, the plaintiff demanded one hundred thousand yuan in compensation from the defendant.

信赖.zh: 这个品牌的质量一直很好，深受消费者信赖。
信赖.en: This brand's quality has always been good, and consumers trust it deeply.

跌.zh: 雪天路滑，他一不小心跌倒在地上。
跌.en: The road was slippery with snow, and he accidentally fell to the ground.

战役.zh: 这场战役在历史上非常有名，最后以少胜多。
战役.en: This battle is very famous in history: the smaller army won in the end.

殴打.zh: 那名球员因为殴打裁判，被禁赛一年。
殴打.en: That player was banned for a year for hitting the referee.

权威.zh: 这本词典是学习汉语最权威的工具书之一。
权威.en: This dictionary is one of the most authoritative reference books for learning Chinese.

偿还.zh: 他向朋友借了一万元，答应半年内偿还。
偿还.en: He borrowed ten thousand yuan from a friend and promised to pay it back within six months.

作风.zh: 新来的经理作风强硬，说一不二。
作风.en: The new manager has a tough style and means what he says.

罢工.zh: 为了要求提高工资，码头工人决定集体罢工三天。
罢工.en: To demand higher pay, the dock workers decided to strike together for three days.

智商.zh: 这个孩子智商很高，十二岁就上大学了。
智商.en: This child has a very high IQ and went to university at twelve.

迈.zh: 毕业以后，他们迈出了走向社会的第一步。
迈.en: After graduating, they took their first step into society.

兜.zh: 我们开着车在城里兜了一圈，才找到停车的地方。
兜.en: We drove around the city before we finally found a place to park.

强制.zh: 这家公司强制员工周末加班，引起了不满。
强制.en: This company forces its employees to work overtime at weekends, which has caused discontent.

师范.zh: 他报考了师范专业，因为他从小就想当老师。
师范.en: He applied for a teacher-training major because he has wanted to be a teacher since childhood.

便利.zh: 网上购物给人们的生活带来了很大的便利。
便利.en: Online shopping has brought great convenience to people's lives.

烹饪.zh: 这家酒店的厨师在全国烹饪比赛中获得了金奖。
烹饪.en: This hotel's chef won the gold medal in a national cooking competition.

免疫.zh: 得过一次水痘的人，一般会终身免疫。
免疫.en: People who have had chickenpox once are usually immune for life.

澄清.zh: 关于这个问题，我想再澄清一下我的意思。
澄清.en: On this question, I'd like to clarify what I meant.

扩散.zh: 工厂泄漏的气体迅速向周围扩散。
扩散.en: The gas leaking from the factory quickly spread to the surrounding area.

预期.zh: 新产品的销量远远低于预期，公司很失望。
预期.en: Sales of the new product were far below expectations, and the company was very disappointed.

过失.zh: 这次项目延误完全是我的过失，不能怪别人。
过失.en: This project delay is entirely my fault; no one else is to blame.

竭尽全力.zh: 虽然我们竭尽全力，最后还是输掉了比赛。
竭尽全力.en: Although we did our utmost, we still lost the match in the end.

依据.zh: 老师依据学生的平时表现给出了最后的成绩。
依据.en: The teacher gave final grades based on the students' everyday performance.

拧.zh: 这个瓶盖太紧了，我怎么也拧不开。
拧.en: This bottle cap is too tight; I can't unscrew it no matter what.

图案.zh: 她在蛋糕上用奶油画了一个心形图案。
图案.en: She drew a heart-shaped pattern on the cake with cream.

规划.zh: 这座城市的规划很合理，道路宽阔，绿地很多。
规划.en: This city is well planned, with wide roads and plenty of green space.

拿手.zh: 唱歌不是他的拿手好戏，跳舞才是。
拿手.en: Singing isn't his speciality; dancing is.

孔.zh: 最近他瘦了不少，只好在皮带上又打了一个孔。
孔.en: He has lost a lot of weight recently, so he had to punch another hole in his belt.

后代.zh: 这位老人的后代现在分散在世界各地。
后代.en: This old man's descendants are now scattered all over the world.

卡通.zh: 这个水杯上印着可爱的卡通图案。
卡通.en: This cup is printed with a cute cartoon picture.

航行.zh: 古代的船员靠星星来判断航行的方向。
航行.en: In ancient times, sailors relied on the stars to determine their sailing direction.

支撑.zh: 全家人的生活都靠他一个人的工资支撑。
支撑.en: The whole family's living is supported by his salary alone.

执着.zh: 她执着地追求自己的梦想，十年来从没放弃。
执着.en: She has pursued her dream with persistence and never given up in ten years.

淋.zh: 最后在蛋糕上淋一层巧克力酱就做好了。
淋.en: Finally, pour a layer of chocolate sauce over the cake and it's done.

同胞.zh: 地震发生后，全国同胞纷纷捐款支援灾区。
同胞.en: After the earthquake, compatriots all over the country donated money to support the disaster area.

伴随.zh: 青春期常常伴随着各种烦恼。
伴随.en: Adolescence is often accompanied by all kinds of worries.

沼泽.zh: 他们在森林里迷路了，差点儿走进一片沼泽。
沼泽.en: They got lost in the forest and nearly walked into a swamp.

祖先.zh: 据说这个村子里的人都有同一个祖先。
祖先.en: It is said that everyone in this village shares the same ancestor.

珍珠.zh: 这种奶茶里加了很多黑色的珍珠，很受欢迎。
珍珠.en: This milk tea has lots of black pearls in it and is very popular.

案例.zh: 这本书收集了很多成功企业的经营案例。
案例.en: This book collects many business cases from successful companies.

折腾.zh: 为了办一个签证，他来回折腾了好几趟。
折腾.en: To get a visa, he had to go back and forth several times.

恼火.zh: 电脑在关键时刻突然死机，真让人恼火。
恼火.en: It's really annoying when the computer suddenly crashes at a crucial moment.

导航.zh: 这个商场太大了，室内导航系统很有用。
导航.en: This mall is so big that the indoor navigation system is very useful.

体面.zh: 参加面试时，最好穿得体面一些。
体面.en: When going to a job interview, it's best to dress respectably.

探望.zh: 春节期间，他回老家探望了多年不见的外婆。
探望.en: During Spring Festival, he went back to his hometown to visit the grandmother he hadn't seen for years.

临床.zh: 这位医生有三十年的临床经验。
临床.en: This doctor has thirty years of clinical experience.

迟钝.zh: 感冒的时候，我的味觉变得很迟钝，吃什么都没味道。
迟钝.en: When I have a cold, my sense of taste becomes dull and nothing tastes of anything.

外界.zh: 这位作家很少接受采访，外界对他的私生活了解不多。
外界.en: This writer rarely gives interviews, so the outside world knows little about his private life.

颇.zh: 这部电影在年轻人中颇受欢迎。
颇.en: This film is quite popular among young people.

准则.zh: 每个医生都必须遵守职业道德准则。
准则.en: Every doctor must abide by the code of professional ethics.

事态.zh: 专家已经赶到现场，正密切关注事态的发展。
事态.en: Experts have arrived at the scene and are closely following how the situation develops.

覆盖.zh: 这个城市的免费网络已经覆盖了所有公园。
覆盖.en: This city's free internet now covers all its parks.

初步.zh: 经过初步检查，医生认为他的骨头没有问题。
初步.en: After a preliminary examination, the doctor believes there is nothing wrong with his bones.

示范.zh: 这所学校被评为全市的示范学校。
示范.en: This school has been named a model school for the whole city.

先前.zh: 他先前在一家银行工作，后来自己开了公司。
先前.en: He previously worked at a bank and later started his own company.

边界.zh: 这个游戏的地图没有边界，可以一直往前走。
边界.en: This game's map has no boundaries; you can keep going forward forever.

挑剔.zh: 这位顾客很挑剔，试了二十双鞋都不满意。
挑剔.en: This customer is very picky; she tried on twenty pairs of shoes and wasn't satisfied with any.

飞翔.zh: 她梦见自己长出了翅膀，在蓝天中飞翔。
飞翔.en: She dreamt that she grew wings and soared through the blue sky.

通缉.zh: 警方发布了通缉令，悬赏寻找这名嫌疑人。
通缉.en: The police issued a wanted notice and offered a reward for finding the suspect.

无赖.zh: 他像个无赖一样，赖在我家不肯走。
无赖.en: Like a scoundrel, he hung around my house and refused to leave.

以免.zh: 使用前请仔细阅读说明书，以免造成不必要的损失。
以免.en: Please read the instructions carefully before use to avoid unnecessary damage.

统统.zh: 这些问题统统由我来负责，你们不用担心。
统统.en: I will take responsibility for all of these problems; you don't need to worry.

搭配.zh: 这道菜用牛肉搭配青椒，味道特别好。
搭配.en: This dish pairs beef with green peppers and tastes especially good.

扰乱.zh: 长时间熬夜会扰乱身体的生物钟。
扰乱.en: Staying up late for long periods disrupts the body's biological clock.

饮食.zh: 中国南北方的饮食习惯差别很大。
饮食.en: Eating habits differ greatly between northern and southern China.

热门.zh: 这个景点是今年夏天最热门的旅游地之一。
热门.en: This attraction is one of the hottest tourist destinations this summer.

审查.zh: 这部电影还要经过审查才能上映。
审查.en: This film still has to pass review before it can be released.

谴责.zh: 这家工厂偷偷往河里排放污水，受到了社会的强烈谴责。
谴责.en: This factory secretly discharged waste water into the river and was strongly condemned by the public.

虚伪.zh: 他当面夸你，背后却说你坏话，真是虚伪。
虚伪.en: He praises you to your face but bad-mouths you behind your back; how hypocritical.

测量.zh: 护士正在给小朋友测量身高和体重。
测量.en: The nurse is measuring the children's height and weight.

推翻.zh: 他推翻了自己原来的计划，决定重新开始。
推翻.en: He threw out his original plan and decided to start again.

威力.zh: 别小看这个小小的辣椒，它的威力可不小。
威力.en: Don't underestimate this tiny chilli; it packs quite a punch.

敬礼.zh: 升国旗时，少先队员们都向国旗敬礼。
敬礼.en: When the national flag is raised, the Young Pioneers all salute it.

吹牛.zh: 别听他吹牛，他其实连游泳都不会。
吹牛.en: Don't listen to his bragging; he actually can't even swim.

辨认.zh: 这些字写得太乱，我辨认了半天才看懂。
辨认.en: These characters were written so messily that it took me ages to make them out.

特意.zh: 知道你要来，他特意请了一天假去机场接你。
特意.en: Knowing you were coming, he specially took a day off to pick you up at the airport.

激发.zh: 这次旅行激发了他学习外语的热情。
激发.en: This trip sparked his enthusiasm for learning foreign languages.

成天.zh: 她成天抱怨工作太累，却从不想换工作。
成天.en: She complains all day long that her job is too tiring, yet never thinks of changing jobs.

姿态.zh: 跳舞时，她的姿态非常优美。
姿态.en: When she dances, her posture is very graceful.

奖赏.zh: 主人用一块饼干作为奖赏，小狗高兴得直摇尾巴。
奖赏.en: Its owner gave the puppy a biscuit as a reward, and it wagged its tail happily.

发财.zh: 他做生意发财以后，回村里修了一条路。
发财.en: After he got rich in business, he went back to his village and built a road.

压迫.zh: 胸口有一种被压迫的感觉，让他喘不过气来。
压迫.en: He had a feeling of pressure on his chest that left him breathless.

金融.zh: 上海是中国重要的金融中心。
金融.en: Shanghai is an important financial centre in China.

界限.zh: 孩子要知道玩笑和伤害之间的界限。
界限.en: Children need to know the line between a joke and hurting someone.

品尝.zh: 到了成都，一定要品尝一下地道的火锅。
品尝.en: When you get to Chengdu, you must try some authentic hotpot.

丸.zh: 奶奶做的肉丸又大又香，我一口气吃了五个。
丸.en: Grandma's meatballs are big and delicious; I ate five in one go.

雕塑.zh: 这位艺术家花了两年时间，用废旧金属做成了一件雕塑。
雕塑.en: The artist spent two years making a sculpture out of scrap metal.

种子.zh: 老师的一句鼓励，在他心里种下了梦想的种子。
种子.en: A word of encouragement from his teacher planted the seed of a dream in his heart.

可行.zh: 专家们讨论后认为，这个方案在技术上是可行的。
可行.en: After discussion, the experts concluded that the plan is technically feasible.

隐蔽.zh: 这只小虫的颜色和树叶一样，隐蔽得很好。
隐蔽.en: This little insect is the same colour as the leaves, so it is well hidden.

手势.zh: 交警用手势指挥着来往的车辆。
手势.en: The traffic officer directed passing vehicles with hand signals.
